{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dearic Garden Club''' was an organization based in [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It's members were interested in gardening and were familiar with the local Talusian flora.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] members of the club helped [[Champhra Biahin]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall's]] ambassador to Talus, locate a sample of the rare medicinal [[Twin-Scented Natterbloom]]. As a token of gratitude Biahin sent a recording of the anthem ''[[Flowers of Drall]]'' sung by young students at the [[Boiling Sea Music Academy]] on Drall to the Garden Club's chairperson, who planned to play it at the club's next meeting.

==Behind the scenes==
This organization is featured in a small quest in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. In this quest, Champhra Biahin asks the player to meet a representative of the club who found a sample of the Twin-Scented Natterbloom and bring the herb back to Biahin. In the next mission, the player is sent into the wilderness once again to deliver a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] containing an anthem to the club's chairperson.
